title: TerritoryReadoutRequest
description: The input derive-territory-readout.mjs reads: a place in the Turtle Island taxonomy (its taxonomy path and plain name) and the territory catalog rows to read against it, each row a territory-catalog-row per this section's own schema (data/records/schema/territory-catalog-row.schema.json), itself an allOf profile over Cistern's resource-row.schema.json.

path.description: The taxonomy node's repo-relative path under turtle-island-ecological-adaptation-services.

rows.description: The territory catalog rows to read the place against.
